subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime object layer: audio-node list name resolution, scene-graph node cleanup/render/bitmask walks, DirectX mesh and texture file loading and D3D texture creation, Bink video playback control, resource-cascade node cleanup, and D3D resource registry release walks.

summary: Reconstructs the generic runtime object layer from twenty validated functions. Seven GUESS classes cover the defensible object clusters: SceneGraphNode (0x0054A770, 0x0054B330, 0x0054BD30, 0x0054C410, 0x0054D030) groups the scene-graph destructor, bitmask clear, render walk and the two audio-child queue cleanups that share the +0x118/+0x11C count/base pair and the SoundManager global; D3DTextureResource (0x0054FB90, 0x0054FD50, 0x00550080, 0x005502C0) groups the default-initializer, mode/rate setter, texture-creation entry point and the conditional destructor over the shared +0x40..+0x54 region; BinkVideo (0x00551CF0, 0x00551EB0, 0x00551F80) groups frame render, volume setter and the close/free wrapper. MeshTextureFileLoader (0x0054AC70), AudioNodeList (0x00549440), AudioFontResource (0x00552760), ResourceCascadeNode (0x005539F0, 0x00553310) and D3DResourceManager (0x00554CC0, 0x00554E10) are single-pair GUESS clusters. MaskedFieldSetter (0x00552FD0) is kept unowned. No state-machine or interface evidence was found. Field semantics and several owner identities remain unresolved and are preserved without forcing a clean design.

function_roles.role: Audio-node list name resolution: walks a singly linked audio-node list from the head at this+0xFC, resolving each node's string name through StringLookupInLinkedDictionary (0x0054A2D0) into node+0x10 and advancing via the node+0x14 next link until null; no-op when the head is null. Invoked from AudioEngineInitialization (0x00546010) during audio engine startup.

Scene-graph node destructor/resource cleanup: drains the first list at this+0x204 (QueueResourceCleanup 0x0054C410, DoublyLinkedListUnlink 0x0054AC30, FreeWrapper_7bcf 0x00587BCF per node), conditionally runs FieldCleanupWithNullCheck (0x00561940) when this+0x1EC is set and LinkedNodeDestruction (0x0054FA50) when this+0x1E0 is set, drains and frees the second list at this+0x224 (next at this+0x228) then zeroes this+0x224, frees the 56-byte-stride array at this+0x22C calling EmptyStub_0170 (0x004B0170) per element then zeroes the pointer; returns 0.

DirectX mesh/texture file loader: reads and parses a binary file into the DirectX pipeline through the global buffers dword_8B8F30/dword_8B8F34 (optionally decompressed via sub_59B260 0x0059B260, else a file-size probe via FileSizeQueryWrapper 0x0058ACE6/sub_587F64 0x00587F64), identifies the format by a 16-byte magic (texture aCubeMts410 vs mesh aCubeMts401), builds the D3D resource via D3DTextureResourceCreation (0x00548190) or DirectXMeshVertexBufferParsingAndLoading (0x00547B40), copies the payload into the caller's *a4 buffer, walks the linked sub-object list via sub_547710 (0x00547710), cleans up both buffers, and reports errors through sub_53C590 (0x0053C590) with the aErrorAllocatin/aErrorReadingSc/aErrorReadingMe/aWrongMtsVersio strings returning -1.

Recursive bitmask clear over a scene-graph-like node chain: clears the current node's own mask this[15] (offset 0x3C) &= ~a2, then, when a3 is non-zero, clears a3's bits from the mask at +0x14 of every node in the child chain rooted at this+0x204 (head then links at +0x10), recurses into the current node when the recursion flag this+0x44 is set, and continues through the sibling pointer this+0x4C while the depth argument a4 keeps the loop alive.

Scene-graph render walk: for each node reads the children-list head at this+0x204 and searches the linked list (child next at node+0x10, flag at node+0x14) for a child whose flag has bit 0x80000 set; when found, registers the current node into the global render list (buffer at dword_8B8F28+336, 24-byte elements, node stored at slot+16, counter at dword_8B8F28+332), recurses into the child pointer at this+0x44 when non-null and continues through the sibling pointer at this+0x4C until the chain ends. Called by VertexBufferResourceAllocation (0x00543FA0).

Queued-resource cleanup during scene-graph teardown: iterates the 64-byte audio-element array (count at this+0x118, base at this+0x11C) detaching each element's reference via sub_547710 (0x00547710) and freeing via AudioResourceFree (0x00540CB0) on the SoundManager global dword_8B78A0, walks the linked list at this+0x13C freeing each node via ObjectDestructorWithArrayCleanup (0x005511A0) + FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), frees the 56-byte-stride array at this+0x110 (count in the header at ptr-4) with EmptyStub_0170 (0x004B0170) per element, and clears the single pointer this+0x144; returns 0. Called by SceneGraph (0x0054A770).

Scene-node child cleanup: when bit 0x8000000 (bit 27) of the flag at this+0x14 is set, iterates this[70] (count at +0x118) child elements (64-byte stride, base at this+0x11C) freeing one audio resource per child via AudioResourceFree (0x00540CB0) on the SoundManager global, then clears bit 0x8000000 and returns 0; the flag clear still runs when the count is non-positive.

Constructor/initializer for a resource object whose dword fields run through offset 0x90: runs the global zero-init helper GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 (0x0053C2A0), memsets the first 0x40 header bytes, then writes explicit defaults into dword fields 0x40..0x90 (enable/usage flags 1 at 0x44/0x48, cap 0x100000 at 0x60, count 4 at 0x64, -1 at 0x68, two 1.0f floats at 0x78/0x7C, zeros elsewhere); returns the this pointer. Used by DirectX mesh/texture resource creation paths.

Mode-and-rate configuration setter: encodes a two-bit mode field at this+0x40 (mask 0xFFFFFFF3 preserves the other bits); a2==8 sets the mode bits to 8 and a2==4 to 4, otherwise the mode bits are cleared. The rate field this+0x44 receives a3 for modes 8/4 (with a -1 sentinel when a3 < 1 in mode 8) or 1 in the default branch. Returns the selected rate in the mode branches and a2 in the default branch. Called by DirectXMeshVertexBufferParsingAndLoading (0x00547B40) and D3DTextureResourceCreation (0x00548190).

D3D texture creation entry point: parses the requested dimensions via sub_5427D0 (0x005427D0), computes mip levels via base-2 logarithms (CRTFtol 0x00587BDC), clamps them against the stored mip field this+0x50, halves the dimensions under the size limits queried from the sound manager (SimpleFieldGetter_bfc0 0x0055BFC0 / IndexedArrayAccess_d890 0x0053D890 on dword_8B78A0, with the global mip-LOD bias dword_8B8E4C), selects a texture format from argument flags (0x800, 0x40000, 0x200000 via KeyEventDispatchToSubHandlers 0x0055C7F0, direct index 8 on unk_800000, fallback via GetVTableParamBasedOnFlagBits 0x0055C3C0 / MaskedFieldGetter 0x0055C9A0), optionally writes a colour key (sub_5435C0 0x005435C0 on the object at this+0x54), writes the mip count into the descriptor field at *(this+0x54)+0x2C, and calls the underlying creation sub_5429B0 (0x005429B0); on any failure runs the destructor path DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear (0x005502C0) and returns -1.

Release/destructor: when the sub-object pointer at this+0x54 is non-null, runs the sub-object cleanup sub_542E50 (0x00542E50), then (if the pointer is still non-null) calls the sentinel EmptyStub_7470 (0x00557470) and frees via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) and zeroes this+0x54; regardless of the pointer state, clears the free/destroy flag at this+0x4 to 0; always returns 0.

Advances and renders one Bink video frame: when BinkWait(*this) (0x0059E340) returns 0, decompresses via BinkDoFrame (0x0059E344), advances via BinkNextFrame (0x0059E348), wraps the this+0x4 frame counter modulo the total frame count at *(bink_handle + 8), resolves a target buffer via ThunkWithArgReorder (0x00543210), copies via BinkCopyToBuffer (0x0059E34C), releases via ArgumentReorderWrapper_3230 (0x00543230), and clears bit 0x400 in a2[6]; a switch on a2[12] (jump table jpt_551D31) selects the copy destination flags. Returns whether the counter wrapped to zero.

Sets the playback volume on a Bink video object: stores a2 into this+0x10 when it differs from the stored float and lies within the bounds dbl_59E430/dbl_59E420, scales it by the constant dbl_5B8990, truncates via CRTFtol (0x00587BDC) and passes it to BinkSetVolume together with the Bink handle at this+0x0.

Conditional cleanup wrapper for a Bink video object: when the object pointer a1 is non-null, closes the Bink video via BinkVideoClose (0x00551CE0), runs the empty stub EmptyStub_7470 (0x00557470), frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) and returns the free result; on a null pointer the guard is skipped and the body returns the uninitialized result register (decompiler artifact). Shared by screen/sound/font resource loaders (0x0048E0D0, 0x0048E110, 0x0048E360, 0x0048E3A0) and a file-load path (0x004F9B70).

Audio/font resource cleanup: always releases the source surface at this+0x64 via sub_53CB90 (0x0053CB90) and clears the pointer; when bit 0x20000 at this+0x24 is set additionally resets the object at this+0xC through ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease (0x00540EB0) on the SoundManager global dword_8B78A0, frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) if it survives, and frees the object at this+0x868 (EmptyStub_7470 0x00557470 + FreeWrapper_7bcf); returns 0.

Trivial two-field masked flag setter: writes (a2 & 0x20) into this+0x4C and (a3 & 0xC0) into this+0x50, returning the masked a2 value; no guards, both fields always written. Called by sub_4D8AB0 (0x004D8AB0) and FontSurfaceLookupDispatch (0x0053D260).

Flag-driven resource cleanup: when bit 0 or bit 1 of the flags at this+0x00 is set, frees the secondary pointer at this+0x18 via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) and zeroes it; independently, a non-null primary pointer at this+0x14 is released through ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease (0x00540EB0) on the SoundManager global dword_8B78A0, freed if it survives the reset, and zeroed; ends with a call to EmptyStub_0170 (0x004B0170). Called from ResourceCascadeCleanup (0x005539F0).

Resource-cascade node free: unlinks the node a1 from its doubly-linked list unconditionally via DoublyLinkedListNodeUnlinkByMatch (0x0055C2E0), then when a1 is non-null runs the resource-specific cleanup handler ConditionalResourceCleanup_3310 (0x00553310) and frees the node via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); returns 0. Used by six cleanup paths across collision, audio and resource subsystems (0x00494900, 0x00499B50, 0x0049EC40, 0x0049ECA0, 0x004D9030, 0x004DCD10).

Release walk over a resource list rooted at (a2+36): for each linked-list node (next at node offset 48) iterates its entries (count at node offset 41, stride 37 dwords, element data at node offset 42); entries whose flag byte (bit 2) is set and that hold a resource at entry+84/4 get released through sub_53F6E0 (0x0053F6E0), EmptyStub_7470 (0x00557470) and FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), then are zeroed and passed to UICleanupIterator (0x00554D70); returns the last count value read. Called by RenderTargetCleanup (0x0053F270).

Two-phase D3D resource-list cleanup: first phase resets device parameters for every slot (count at this+0x13B0, table starting at this+4472, 17-DWORD steps) via StateParameterSetterWithVirtualDeviceNotify (0x00554610) with a null second argument; second phase, only when a2 is non-null, walks the resource-group list (head via a2+272 then the node pointer at +40, next at DWORD index 23) calling UICleanupIterator (0x00554D70) on each item (96-byte stride) whose flag at (DWORD index 21)+24 has bit 0x80000 clear. Invoked by sub_4A0250 (0x004A0250), RenderTargetCleanup (0x0053F270) and sub_554F80 (0x00554F80).

classes.name: SceneGraphNode
classes.responsibility: Scene-graph node with a children list, sibling/child pointers, an audio-child element array and several child-resource containers; supports mask/bitmask clearing (0x0054B330), render-list registration (0x0054BD30), node destructor (0x0054A770) and audio-child queue cleanup (0x0054C410, 0x0054D030).

classes.name: BinkVideo
classes.responsibility: Bink video playback object: owns the Bink handle and the current-frame counter with modulo wrap over the total frame count stored in the handle; renders frames into a resolved surface, sets scaled volume, and closes/frees the object.

classes.name: D3DTextureResource
classes.responsibility: D3D texture resource object: dword fields through offset 0x90 including a free/destroy flag, a two-bit mode field, a flag word, the mip count, the texture-descriptor pointer and default literals (cap 0x100000, count 4, -1 sentinel, 1.0f scales); constructed with defaults (0x0054FB90), mode/rate configured (0x0054FD50), created from a name (0x00550080) and destructed conditionally (0x005502C0).

classes.name: MeshTextureFileLoader
classes.responsibility: File loader that reads a binary mesh/texture file through the shared dword_8B8F30/dword_8B8F34 buffer pair, detects the format by 16-byte magic, builds the corresponding D3D resource and copies the payload into a caller-owned buffer.

classes.name: AudioNodeList
classes.responsibility: Audio-node list whose head is stored at this+0xFC and whose nodes hold a resolved-name slot at +0x10 and a next link at +0x14; resolved against the linked string dictionary during audio engine startup.

classes.name: AudioFontResource
classes.responsibility: Audio/font resource object holding a source surface, a flag word and two manager-owned object pointers; cleanup releases the surface and, under bit 0x20000 of the flag word, the sound-manager objects.

classes.name: ResourceCascadeNode
classes.responsibility: Resource node with type flags and a primary/secondary resource slot pair; unlinked from a doubly-linked list, cleaned by a flag-driven handler and freed during resource cascade teardown.

classes.name: D3DResourceManager
classes.responsibility: D3D resource registry: releases entries of a resource list rooted at an external context and resets the device parameter table plus the resource-group chains of a D3D context.

compatibility_contracts.name: MeshTextureFileLoad
compatibility_contracts.description: Loading a mesh/texture file must read it through the dword_8B8F30/dword_8B8F34 global buffer pair (optionally decompressed via 0x0059B260), detect the format from the 16-byte magic (texture aCubeMts410 vs mesh aCubeMts401), build the D3D resource via 0x00548190/0x00547B40, copy the payload into the caller's *a4 buffer, clean up both buffers, and return -1 (reporting through 0x0053C590 with the aErrorAllocatin/aErrorReadingSc/aErrorReadingMe/aWrongMtsVersio strings) on any allocation, read-count or magic failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: SceneGraphTeardown
compatibility_contracts.description: Scene-graph teardown must drain and free the lists at this+0x204 and this+0x224, run FieldCleanupWithNullCheck (0x00561940) / LinkedNodeDestruction (0x0054FA50) when their pointers are set, free the 56-byte-stride array at this+0x22C (EmptyStub_0170 per element) and the audio-element array (count this+0x118, base this+0x11C) via AudioResourceFree on the SoundManager global, then zero the freed pointers.

compatibility_contracts.name: D3DTextureCreate
compatibility_contracts.description: Creating a D3D texture must compute and clamp the mip count from the requested dimensions against this+0x50, halve the dimensions under the sound-manager size limits and the mip-LOD bias dword_8B8E4C, select a format from the argument flags, write the mip count into the descriptor at *(this+0x54)+0x2C, invoke the underlying creation 0x005429B0, and run the destructor 0x005502C0 with return -1 on failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: BinkVideoFrame
compatibility_contracts.description: Advancing a Bink video must wait on the handle (*this), decompress and advance via BinkDoFrame/BinkNextFrame, wrap the this+0x4 counter modulo the total frame count at *(handle + 8), select the copy destination flags by the a2[12] switch, copy via BinkCopyToBuffer into the surface resolved by 0x00543210, and report whether the counter wrapped to zero.

compatibility_contracts.name: ResourceCascadeFree
compatibility_contracts.description: Freeing a resource-cascade node must unlink it from its doubly-linked list (0x0055C2E0), run the type-flag-driven handler 0x00553310 (free the +0x18 slot under flag bits 0/1 at +0x0, release the +0x14 slot via the SoundManager global), and free the node allocation.

unresolved: Owner identity is UNKNOWN for 0x00552FD0; all other class owners are GUESS groupings inferred from shared field offsets and call relationships, not confirmed by the packet.

Grouping 0x0054C410 and 0x0054D030 into SceneGraphNode rests on the shared +0x118/+0x11C count/base pair, the 64-byte element stride and the AudioResourceFree-on-SoundManager pattern; common ownership is not proven.

The relationship between the children-list head at this+0x204 and the walk base rendered as *(this+0x214) is not established; the child-node field refs modeled as *(this+0x214)/*(*(this+0x214)+0x10) may describe the same structure or a second one.
field:this:0x00000214 and field:this:0x00000218 are listed by the deterministic field extraction as read in 0x0054B330 but do not appear in the visible decompiled body; 0x00000218 stays unresolved.
The meaning of the visibility flag bit 0x80000 (0x0054BD30) and the layout of the global render list at dword_8B8F28+336 beyond the stored node pointer at slot+16 are not defined by the packet.
The exact meaning of the resolved value written to node+0x10 by AudioNodeUpdateWalk (dictionary entry pointer vs ID) depends on StringLookupInLinkedDictionary, outside this packet.

The format indices 5/8/9 and the flag masks 0x800/0x40000/0x200000/0x1000000 used by D3DTextureCreation have no authoritative enum mapping; the roles of globals dbl_59E880 and dbl_5B8908 are unestablished.
The meaning of the two-bit mode field at this+0x40 (0/4/8) and the rate field this+0x44 is DERIVED from the skeleton fill, not verifiable from this packet.

The switch values on a2[12] and the 0x400 bit cleared in a2[6] of BinkVideoFrameRender map to render-path flags whose semantics are not established; the a2 fields (a2[6], a2[8], a2[10], a2[12]) are not covered by the packet field evidence.

The constant-to-global mapping for the Bink volume bounds (dbl_59E430 = 0.0, dbl_59E420 = 1.0) and the scaling factor (dbl_5B8990 = 32768.0) is DERIVED from the embedded skeleton prose, not from the raw source.
EmptyStub_7470 and EmptyStub_0170 perform no visible work; their purpose relative to the surrounding close/free sequences is unknown.
The null branch of 0x00551F80 reads an uninitialized result register in the decompilation; effective behavior on null input is undefined in the raw source.
Semantics of the SoundManager global dword_8B78A0 and the UI/D3D context global dword_8B8F28 are DERIVED from existing analysis, not grounded in this packet.
The audio child element type at this+0x11C (64-byte stride) is unidentified; the 56-byte-stride element layouts at this+0x110 and this+0x22C are unnamed.
The child-resource distinction between FieldCleanupWithNullCheck (0x00561940) and LinkedNodeDestruction (0x0054FA50) is not confirmed.

The node and entry layouts of D3DResourceRelease (next at node offset 48, count at 41, data base at 42, flag at -19, resource slot at entry+84/4) and the parameter-table stride of D3DResourceListCleanup (17 DWORDs, 96-byte item stride) are numeric offsets from the raw source with no named packet field entries.
The meaning of flag bits 0 and 1 at this+0x00 and of the 0x20000/0x8000000/0x80000 flags used by the cleanup functions is not established by this packet.

The 0x0054B330 base expression *(*(this+0x214)+0x10) attached to the child-chain 0x10/0x14 field refs does not literally match the source's this[129] (offset 0x204) head dereference; whether they describe the same structure is unresolved.
What the node a1 in 0x005539F0 points at and which resource type it belongs to is caller-dependent and not named in the packet.
The global dword_8B78A0 is marked read in 0x005539F0 but does not appear in its raw source; its use is in a callee.
D3DResourceRelease is prelabeled as a structural twin of sub_45B5C0; that DERIVED prelabel is not confirmed.
